Hello, my friend! I am Ananse. Today we are going to count from one to ten.
Here come the mangoes. Count them with me.
Five mangoes. This is five. One whole hand!
Ten mangoes. This is ten. Two hands!
Let us count them all together, one more time.
There are ten mangoes. We counted all the way to ten!
Now it is your turn. Count the mangoes and feed Ananse!
